web-guide-idea-68.audience: Learners revising a defined topic before an assessment.
web-guide-idea-68.offer: Teach a focused revision workshop within your subject expertise. A narrow scope lets participants practise rather than passively hear a syllabus summary.
web-guide-idea-68.steps.0: Name the exact topic and assumed knowledge.
web-guide-idea-68.steps.1: Review key ideas through worked examples.
web-guide-idea-68.steps.2: Let participants attempt new questions and discuss reasoning.
web-guide-idea-68.equipment: A phone with paper or whiteboard framing; a laptop or tablet is optional.
web-guide-idea-68.returnReason: Offer the next topic or a deeper practice session after learners try the first set.
web-guide-idea-68.promotion: Share one sample problem and the intended level. Do not promise marks or complete assessed work.
web-guide-idea-68.metadataTitle: Exam Revision Workshop — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-68.metadataDescription: Lead a focused revision session on one subject or topic you are equipped to teach. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
